attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the accounts through RDP from an external source.
description: An unusual successful RDP connection by a user from an external IP. This may be indicative of using stolen credentials or malicious activity.
investigative_actions: Identify the user performing RDP and check that it is authorized. Check whether this IP has a malicious reputation. Reset the user's password. Follow further actions done by the user.
name: Suspicious External RDP Login
